يستسمحوا (form X)
# يَسْتَسْمِحُوا (yastasmiḥū) /jas.tas.mi.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
# يُسْتَسْمَحُوا (yustasmaḥū) /jus.tas.ma.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَسْمَحَ (istasmaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
